Confidentiality and realism note
This is a synthetic test fixture used to exercise the bd-market-memo skill's handling of vague, underspecified meeting notes. It is not a real meeting and not real HubSpot data. Every prospect, partner, association, person, commercial detail, and conversation is fictional and created for classroom/testing use.

Test intent: this fixture has a date, participants, and discussion content (so it should NOT fail the basic non-empty/structure check), but it deliberately has no named owners, no specific dates, and no confident commitments in "Where the Meeting Was Left." A correct memo draft must mark every follow-up's Owner and Timeline as TBD rather than inventing a name or date, and should note low confidence throughout rather than presenting speculation as fact.
